title: Tangent planes of a rectifiable set and of its image under a bi-Lipschitz C¹ map: T_{φx}φ(M) = Dφ(x)T_xM a.e.
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, M ⊆ U Borel and countably n-rectifiable with H^n(M ∩ C) < ∞ for every compact C ⊆ U, and φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P a C¹ map with Dφ(x) injective for every x, Λ-Lipschitz and Λ-antilipschitz, with φ^{-1}(U) = U. Then for H^n-a.e. x ∈ M, with Q(x) := approxTangentPlane n M x: M has the approximate tangent space Q(x) at x, and φ(M) has the approximate tangent space Dφ(x)(Q(x)) at φ(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → M ⊆ U → CountablyRectifiable n M → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M ∩ C) ≠ ∞) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ φ x)) → LipschitzWith Λ φ → AntilipschitzWith Λ φ → φ ⁻¹' U = U → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (approxTangentPlane n M x) ∧ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (φ '' M) (φ x) (Submodule.map (fderiv ℝ φ x : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) (approxTangentPlane n M x))
